entries.title: Psalms 59:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Run - To and fro, to receive Saul's commands, and to execute them with all speed.

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The God - A God in covenant with all true Israelites, whom thou hast promised to protect and bless. The heathen - Or, these heathens, who though they are Israelites by birth; yet in their dispositions they are mere Heathens. Be not - For indeed thou canst not according to thy word, be merciful to such incorrigible offenders.

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Return - Watching for me: which they did at this time all the night long, 1Sam 19:11 . A dog - When he is pursuing his prey. Go round - When they did not find him in his own house, they sought for him in other parts of the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pour out - Sharp and bitter word's, abundantly and vehemently, as a fountain doth waters, as this word signifies. Swords - Words as keen and mischievous as swords. For who - David doth not hear us, and God either doth not hear, or not regard what we say.

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Prevent - Thou wilt help me sooner than I expect.

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: My people - Over whom thou hast appointed me to be governor in due time. Forget - Their former danger, and thy glorious mercy in delivering them. Scatter - Let them wander from place to place, that they may carry the tokens of thy justice, and their own shame to all places.

entries.title: Psalms 59:12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pride - For their proud and insolent speeches against thee. Lying - For their execrations and lying reports, which they have spread concerning me.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Not be - In the land of the living any more.
